Lucide (https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide), ISC licence (LICENSE, from lucide@0.469.0 on npm). No Lucide files are
loaded: some of its icons' paths are written into js/card-deco.js (ico()), built as SVG nodes. This folder carries the
licence those paths come with, so it ships in the app (resources/web/vendor/lucide).
